content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00231 The RTE shall set the length value of the dynamic length signal for Normal Data Path in COM or length of the IPdu for Large Data Path in COM to the value of the defined size indicator in the variable-size array, if the value of a data element is transmitted from COM and the data element • is typed by a uint8 variable-size Array and • is mapped by a SenderReceiverToSignalMapping to a SystemSignal and • the corresponding ISignal (s) do not reference a DataTransformation
